hypothesis.mechanism: Information and capital are incorporated gradually, creating persistent multi-hour BTC trend states.
hypothesis.counter_hypothesis: The apparent state has no positive expectancy after 60 bps costs and multiplicity correction.
hypothesis.falsification: Reject unless at least 60 non-overlapping trades, Sharpe above 0.5, and the adjusted net lower bound is positive.
hypothesis.entry_rule: one-hour trailing mean above four-hour trailing mean
